newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: STATE BUDGET COLLECTS MORE THAN PLAN IN H1 '97.
newsitem.headline: STATE BUDGET COLLECTS MORE THAN PLAN IN H1 '97.

text.p: The Lithuanian government said on Tuesday that the state budget revenues during the first half of 1997 were 2.804 billion litas, 84 million litas more than planned.
The state budget revenues in June were 502.7 million litas, 30 million litas more than planned, the government's press office said in a statement.
Improved revenue collection is a key goal of the right-of-centre government, which says it is aiming for a balanced budget by the year 2000.
